description: This class 'ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl' is a Data Access Object implementation for managing 'IntegrationModule' entities related to module configurations in a Spring-based Java application using QueryDSL for database queries.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access for IntegrationModule entities, providing methods to retrieve module configurations by name or code.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule entities filtered by the module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule entity based on its unique module code.
